backend: Actual NC FreeBSD InnerA source; supplemental dedicated TLS collector process on distinct pc08 worker; host root and provisioning remain trusted.
scope: Actual auth.log bytes travel over TLS1.3 with mutual certificate authentication. Receiver binds client CN to device and offset/hash, durably fsyncs before acknowledgment, and source persists its cursor only after a matching response.
No source audit bytes, private credential files or private VM disks are exported in this public bundle. Public records retain offset/hash, marker presence and exact certificate fingerprints.
Service restart, configured capacity/backpressure, source rotation and broader retention remain separate pending tests. One-year retention and organizational adoption are not inferred.
